title: Fix super_admin role edit in Members modal, interactive Profile form in Settings, and Sidebar profile navigation
assumptions: Issue 1: In Members.tsx & backend users.py, support super_admin in role dropdown, prevent self-demotion, support PUT & PATCH /api/users/{user_id}.
Issue 2: In Settings.tsx & backend users.py, convert Profile tab to interactive form supporting full_name, phone, bio, password update via PUT /api/users/me.
Issue 3: In Sidebar.tsx, add convenient navigation to /profile for all roles (via bottom user card click and navItems menu link), ensuring Profile.tsx works seamlessly.
